objective: Adjudicate only the M473 fused-forwarded zero-extra-bubble assumption with a standalone 96-lane pipeline: one-ahead synchronous parent scratch read, same-address RAW forwarding, residual row accumulation and final signed12 scratch plus signed19 psum dual write.

numeric_domain.normal_residual_beat: Each of 96 lanes is one sign-extended INT8 weight/contribution represented on the signed12 input port; arbitrary signed12 streams are not admitted.
numeric_domain.row_final_bound_source: Frozen M468 exact lazy-PWP audit, minimum -1089 and maximum 1059; RTL additionally blocks any directed out-of-domain final overflow before ready/write.
numeric_domain.psum_bound_source: M41 independent checkpoint audit: checkpoint_tight_signed_bits=19; input ordering/prefix remains the frozen H67 K16 schedule.

microarchitecture_contract.scratch_macro_cut: External 64-row by 96-lane signed12 scratch, synchronous registered-Q read, one read plus one write per cycle. Macro area/timing/power are not in this RTL.
microarchitecture_contract.one_ahead: A scratch read accepted with current final issue must permit an ID-correlated dependent first issue at the immediately next clock edge using registered macro Q.
microarchitecture_contract.raw_forward: If next-parent prefetch address equals the same-cycle final scratch write address, suppress macro read and capture final row data into the single parent buffer.
microarchitecture_contract.final_dual_write: The accepted final residual beat produces scratch_write, psum_write and row_complete in that same work cycle; no separate parent-read or row-completion cycle is allowed.
microarchitecture_contract.overflow_atomicity: Any signed12 row or signed19 psum final overflow must deassert issue_ready/psum_write, suppress scratch_write/row_complete, and latch protocol_error before state mutation.
microarchitecture_contract.scheduler_fail_close: issue_valid may be asserted only after the required parent Q/buffer is ready; an early parent-dependent valid is a protocol fault, not an elastic wait.

admission_rule.micro_functional_go: Exact-SHA VCS PASS, all directed counts and nine SVA covers nonempty, no assertion failure, and independent post-run hammer.
admission_rule.next_gate: 3.0 ns TSMC28 pre-macro DC/STA of the 96-lane logic, followed by explicit target 144-byte 1R1W macro timing/energy. A timing failure or any extra issue bubble kills M473 fused performance.

fail_closed: Abort on any frozen SHA, M473 status, M41 19-bit identity, compile, assertion, count or cover mismatch.
Never convert M473 fused 1.943581x or 1.949744x into an admitted performance claim from this directed micro test.
Never include scratch macro PPA or call external scratch timing closed from pre-macro logic-only results.
Never generalize the normal input contract from sign-extended INT8 and at most 16 unique sources to arbitrary signed12 beats.
